templates.headline: Settling on {cheapestSettlementDate} instead of today costs {savingIfSettledOnCheapestDate} less
templates.body: To settle today you would pay {settlementAmountToday}: outstanding principal of {outstandingPrincipal}, interest accrued to date of {accruedInterest} and a settlement fee of {settlementFee}. [[arrearsAmount: This includes overdue instalments of {arrearsAmount}. ]][[coverRefundToday: An insurance refund of {coverRefundToday} is due back to you. ]][[savingIfSettledOnCheapestDate: If you settle on {cheapestSettlementDate}, after the scheduled instalments due before then ({instalmentsBeforeCheapestDate}), your total outflow is {savingIfSettledOnCheapestDate} lower. ]][[salaryLinked: This loan is linked to your salary transfer, so benefits tied to it may change once it is settled.]]
